verdict.rationale: Evidence explicitly states CMS IndusLaw is 'an independent, full-service, law firm in India' with offices only in Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi & NCR, Hyderabad, and Mumbai — all within India. There is no evidence of the firm itself maintaining offices or qualified practices in other countries; international reach is only via affiliation with the separate CMS network, not IndusLaw's own multi-country footprint.
